fixedP1.portableScope: Lazy JS dependency analysis and bounded cancellation/retry design may transfer with pinned-version equivalence tests. Browser fetch already handles compression. This commit adds no browser-readable bootstrap, format, CORS permission or SABR transport.

browserFindings.swJsData: HTTP200 but MissingAllowOriginHeader from ordinary Pages and opaque frame; not readable.
browserFindings.config: Ordinary Pages POST gets403 and no ACAO. Opaque same endpoint succeeds200 without keys, visitor seed, credentials or custom headers. WEB provides own visitor and configInfo; embedded provides own visitor/configData but no configInfo fields.
browserFindings.playbackMetadata: Epoitaitaye DJzjkMBMook, Maite WtTRMAoN2Fw and control gpfVjKXVnDc: WEB with/without configInfo all OK with exact IDs and SABR-only metadata. Embedded using its own config visitor errors with zero audio for all three.
browserFindings.opaqueDataLimit: globalConfig was empty. Encoded config blobs were inspected for size/markers only, not assigned undocumented protobuf semantics. Absence of a plaintext marker is not proof that arbitrary binary fields lack related information.
browserFindings.noPlaybackClaim: No provider media was requested, no decoding or playback was attempted, and no mobile or physical lock-screen claim is made.

primaryImplementations.finding: Documents sw.js_data session bootstrap and /config mapping used in this browser experiment.
Removes configInfo when changing from WEB to another client; WEB config fields were not transplanted into embedded.
The primary browser SABR example requires its ytc-bridge extension. It is not a pure-PWA recipe under this task constraints.
Onesie example requires separate TV player configuration and embedded encryption material; readable /config fields do not establish that mapping. No key or Onesie request was attempted.

conclusion: A new anonymous browser-readable config bootstrap is demonstrated. It does not resolve embedded playback or supply direct audio. No further high-probability pure-PWA SABR/Onesie route was supported by the inspected primary implementations; stop instead of repeating blocked transport or importing tokens/extensions.
